mcat_description.short: Prefabricated house extensions are factory-built or site-assembled structural additions to existing homes, typically supplied as glass-enclosed terrace rooms, rooftop prefab rooms, or modular upper-floor additions using aluminium/steel frames with tempered glass or PUF panel infill.
mcat_description.long: House extensions in the Indian prefab market are predominantly glass-enclosed or modular room additions built on terraces, rooftops, or as lateral annexes to existing residential structures. The dominant commercial form is an aluminium-framed, tempered-glass enclosure installed on a terrace or balcony, functioning as a sunroom, home office, or leisure space. Secondary forms include PUF-panel or steel-frame prefab rooms added as upper-floor extensions, verandas, and modular 1–2 room additions. Structures are governed by BIS IS 13831 (Code of Practice for Prefabricated Buildings) and IS 14807 (Guidelines for Modular Construction Systems), and require local municipal building permission for permanent additions.

market_context: In the Indian market, 'House Extensions' under prefabricated structures is commercially dominated by glass-enclosed terrace and rooftop room additions, with aluminium framing being the dominant structural material. Keyword and listing data confirm that buyers primarily search for 'glass house', 'terrace glass house', and 'glass room on terrace' — not the generic MCAT name. Secondary product types include PUF-panel prefab rooftop rooms and modular upper-floor additions. Relevant BIS standards include IS 13831 (Code of Practice for Prefabricated Buildings) and IS 14807 (Guidelines for Modular Construction Systems); IS 15916 and IS 15917 govern prefabricated concrete and mixed/composite construction respectively. Sellers are concentrated in NCR (Gurugram, Delhi), Chennai, Pune, and Ahmedabad. The market spans residential homeowners, farmhouse developers, and hospitality properties. Structures require local municipal building permission for permanent additions. The category is distinct from standalone prefabricated houses (a sibling MCAT) in that extensions are additions to existing structures, not independent buildings.
